transcript: Speaker A: Our first product, Wispr Flow, is the fastest and most reliable voice dictation model ever built. It's 3-4x more accurate than Siri, ElevenLabs, and OpenAI. Let me show you how it works. Just press the shortcut, and Flow works in any application. It's insanely fast, works everywhere, gets names right, and even fixes your mistakes. It's great for whiteboarding and you can even whisper. Speaker B: Wispr Flow is going after one of the most exciting opportunities in AI today, reimagining the primary interface between humans and machines.
on_screen_text: Wispr Flow: fastest and most reliable voice dictation model. 3-4x more accurate than Siri, ElevenLabs, OpenAI. Insanely fast, works everywhere, gets names right, fixes mistakes, tags files automatically, gets variable names right. Wispr Flow is one of the most exciting opportunities in AI today.
summary: The ad introduces Wispr Flow, a highly accurate and fast voice dictation tool. The presenter demonstrates key features like cross-app integration, auto-correction, and whisper detection. An investor highlights its potential to revolutionize human-machine interfaces.
